name: Thanksgiving To Go
description: A Thanksgiving bar that fits in one bag: four bottles (bourbon, Koskenkorva Apple, sweet vermouth and prosecco), plus Angostura, the brown-sugar-cinnamon and honey syrups, sugar cubes, cranberry, orange, lemon and lime juice, and ginger beer. The first three are batched at home and are the ones to photograph; the rest are made to order from the same bag.

drinks.note: Batch: mix the base at home; ginger beer and ice go in on site.
Batch: base in a pitcher; add the prosecco at the table.
Batch: bottle it the night before and freeze it.
Shake to order with the same bourbon.
Built in the glass; no shaker needed.
For the toast, with the prosecco you brought.
No alcohol, for drivers and kids.
After dinner, if the host has a kettle.
